title: Boxes2Pixels: Learning Defect Segmentation from Noisy SAM Masks
mechanism: Treat pseudo-masks as a noisy teacher and apply one-sided online self-correction: relax background supervision where the student is confident a defect is present, targeting teacher false negatives.
adaptation: Take only the one-sided rule for our missed crack labels (audit: issues in 24 of 239 train crack cells; E1 recall 0.17-0.21): after warm-up, drop background loss on thin confident EMA components (p>0.9) more than 2 px from any crack label; never add crack targets.
evidence: R: wind turbine blade set, binary IoU +9.71 over strongest weak baseline, binary recall +18.56 from self-correction alone.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + background-loss drop for confident thin components after 5k steps; baseline: PF; metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and CV relR@2; kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.02 and CV relP@2 falls > 0.02.
prior_overlap: none: noisy-label methods never tried; D15/D36 list the paper only for box supervision.

alt_notes.adaptation: Loss for training on FM-labelled pool half-cells: FM labellers miss thin cracks, so relax background CE where the house student is confident of crack; keep real labels for the 478 cells.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Only after a labeller passes G0: PF + labeller pseudo-labels with vs without one-sided relaxation; H36 inactive IoU and F51 crack relF1@2; kill under margin M.
